arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE transparent 2D Cartoon sprite, SHARK037. Image1 controls exact original pose, facing, body visibility, pupils and expression. Image2 is STYLE ONLY: gray upper skin, cream/pale underside, crisp black outlines and simple cel shading. Final dive phase: ONLY exposed rear-body/tail above a wide splash, NO head or eyes visible. Gray tail/rear silhouette lies at upper-left/center with fin lobes curving upward; white/pale-blue foam bursts below and stretches in low droplets far to RIGHT. Source body is mostly submerged. Do not complete a whole shark, draw a head, or add a dark puddle. Match original geometry before style. Attached source water must be white/pale-blue foam and light-blue water only, with transparent gaps and NO dark shadow/puddle. No scenery, floor, horizon, extra animals, glow or text. Preserve whole source silhouette with ample transparent margin. Genuine alpha background. Mouth pink/red, teeth white.
